system_a.summary: Recent reviews (2024–2026) are largely positive. Guests repeatedly praise the location, described as close to downtown, walkable to restaurants, and convenient for exploring Asheville. They also mention cleanliness, a comfortable bed, a full kitchen, a sauna, a coffee bar, easy check-in, private parking and entrance, and a responsive, friendly host. Many recent reviews are brief and focus mainly on location. Recent guests describe the space as spacious and quiet, though two (2025, 2026) report hearing footsteps from upstairs during daytime hours, which they found manageable with a noise machine or headphones. One guest noted the listing is mainly a place to sleep. Historical reviews (2016–2018) include serious complaints about cleanliness, bugs, musty furnishings, dated decor, thin floors, limited privacy, and no TV; later years rarely repeat the cleanliness complaints. Guests often describe the place as budget-friendly and best suited to short stays, with some updates noted in 2023–2024.

selected_claims.claim: Location is the most consistently praised feature across the whole review period. Guests describe a short, cheap ride or an easy drive to downtown Asheville, with some restaurants walkable. One 2016 reviewer called it about a mile from downtown, not bike friendly, with $20 peak Uber fares.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Praise appears in every period through 2026. The negative view dates from 2016.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Many 2025 location reviews use near-identical wording, so they may not be independent corroboration.

selected_claims.claim: Upstairs footsteps are a recurring noise concern in this basement apartment. Reports in 2018, 2025 and 2026 describe audible footsteps, thin floors, and noise from 7am to 9pm, and guests coped with a noise machine or headphones. Other guests, from 2016 through 2025, found it very quiet or heard nothing from upstairs.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Footstep complaints include recent 2025-2026 reports, so the issue has appeared recently. Quiet reports also continue to late 2025.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Experience likely depends on upstairs occupancy and timing. Frequency cannot be determined from the ledger.

selected_claims.claim: Privacy and security concerns were raised by a small minority. In 2016 a guest said an internal stairway door connects the unit to the host's upstairs space and felt unsafe. In 2018 a guest said the shared laundry room, accessible to an upstairs tenant, was unlocked on arrival. Many other guests describe the unit as private with a separate entrance, and several describe the area as safe, including one solo female traveler in 2023.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Concerns date from 2016 and 2018. Privacy praise continues through 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No later reviews confirm or refute the connecting door or laundry-room access, so current status is unknown.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness is praised in the large majority of reviews, including recent ones (spotless, clean). Two 2016 reviews were severely negative, citing a filthy bathroom, bugs and spiders, mildew, and a musty couch.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negative reports are all from 2016. Positive reports run from 2016 through 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Nothing shows whether the 2016 problems were resolved, though later reviews do not repeat them.

selected_claims.claim: Hosts are widely described as responsive, accommodating and friendly, with easy self check-in, flexible timing, and easy-to-find parking beside the private entrance. One 2016 guest found the host unhelpful and unreachable over a weekend.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Positive reports span 2016-2026. The negative report is from 2016.
selected_claims.uncertainty: The single negative report is not corroborated by others.

selected_claims.claim: Comfort is mostly rated highly, especially the beds and linens, and the apartment is described as spacious and cozy. Critics mention worn or dated furnishings, a spartan feel, very little natural light in the walkout basement, a small bathroom, and a bad bed in 2016. A 2016 guest also said there was no way to control the heat or cold, and a 2019 guest said a separate AC unit and fans were provided.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Bed praise continues through 2025. Furnishing and lighting criticisms are from 2016-2019.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Dated-decor remarks may reflect preference. A 2023 note says upgrades were in progress, and a 2024 reviewer called it newly renovated.

selected_claims.claim: Amenities are well liked: full kitchen, free coffee bar, honor-system snacks and beer, toiletries, strong water pressure, and a sauna mentioned frequently from 2023 to 2026. Criticisms include no TV in early reviews, though a 2022 guest mentions a Roku TV, and a 2018 reviewer said the listing specified no TV.
selected_claims.time_qualification: The sauna appears only in reviews from 2023 onward. No-TV complaints are from 2016-2019.

selected_claims.claim: Value is mostly seen as good or affordable. One 2016 guest said $150 a night was not worth it compared with a cheap hotel, and some say 'nothing fancy' or 'you get what you pay for'.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Complaints date from 2016-2018. Positive value comments continue to 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Prices are not given for recent stays.

selected_claims.claim: Listing accuracy is mostly confirmed ('as advertised', 'as described'). A 2016 reviewer called the photos misleading, and a 2018 reviewer said it was not as private as described.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negative reports are from 2016 and 2018. Positive reports run through 2025.
